transcript.customer: Can you search for a matte botanical fabric with cotton, in muted olive?

advice.text:
I checked both fabric knowledge and the retail search, but neither returned a match for matte, cotton-containing botanicals in muted olive. The knowledge index has partial coverage, so that doesn’t mean such a fabric doesn’t exist.

The direction is still worth pursuing: softly drawn foliage on a muted olive ground could give you botanical detail without a glossy finish. Would you prefer to broaden the colour to sage or moss, or keep olive and consider a different composition?

transcript.customer: Does finding a Fabric Master record mean I can buy it?

advice.text:
No. A Fabric Master record can help me check a fabric’s identity and recorded characteristics, but it does not establish that you can buy it. Records may include unpublished fabrics or ones whose retail availability hasn’t been verified.

Only an approved retail result lets me present a fabric as a shopping option, and even that is not a promise of current stock or price. Neither of the earlier searches returned a match for your brief.
